name: 73044 · Guthrie, OK
findings: ZIP 73044 (Guthrie) has 69 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 13 organizations.
Youth organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 73044 (Guthrie) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
50% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 73044 (Guthrie) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 44% of the typical level).
